description: The event object of onViewportChanged (epic 4 entry 14, docs/contract.md): where the map is looking, fired when the map first settles and at every move end, never during a move. The same object the component writes to its viewport prop.

center.description: The map's centre, [lng, lat], WGS 84, to 6 decimals.

zoom.description: The zoom, 0 (the world) to 24, to 2 decimals.

bounds.description: The visible bounds, [[west, south], [east, north]], WGS 84, to 6 decimals.
